findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the sanitizer bucket connected to the bar dish machine was empty when the inspector arrived. During the inspection the empty bucket was switched with a new one and the dish machine re-tested at 100 ppm (Cl). Ensure that food contact surfaces are always properly sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the soda gun and the ice machine drop guard soiled. 
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 
The ice machine drop guard and the soda gun were both washed and sanitized during the inspection.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed ice machine to be soiled with black debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as needed.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the tray of the pizza oven to be soiled with an accumulation of food debris. Clean and maintain the tray of the pizza oven to prevent cross contamination.750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the ice scoop out on top of the ice machine--and popcorn scoop stored out on the table top. Provide a container for the scoops.
750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment:
Observed a home dishwasher behind the bar. Discussed with the owner --no sanitizer and does not reach 180 degrees.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
Observed the drain to have 4 hoses stuffed in it. Cut off the drain hoses so they just fit in the drain.
750-1070 Non potable water shall not contact, directly or indirectly, food, potable water, equipment that contacts food or utensils.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Ceiling tile in the back storage area with one missing. Replace the ceiling tile.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
